SLANG.gloss: informal language consisting of words and expressions that are not considered…
SLANG.definition: Informal language consisting of words and expressions that are not considered appropriate for formal occasions; often vituperative or vulgar.
SLANG.example: Their speech was full of slang expressions.

GAS.gloss: the state of matter distinguished from the solid and liquid states by
GAS.definition: The state of matter distinguished from the solid and liquid states by: relatively low density and viscosity; relatively great expansion and contraction with changes in pressure and temperature; the ability to diffuse readily; and the spontaneous tendency to become distributed uniformly throughout any container.
